integrity: Complete analytic proof of the stated dimension-free bounds; packaged exact algebraic checker and finite examples are supplementary. No independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real fourth-moment centering only. The two universal coefficients are not optimized; the exact norm away from the unrestricted endpoint is not determined. Full original text of two historical comparison papers was not available.
title: Quadratic event-mass rigidity for the real fourth-moment centering norm
